name: Upscale Video
description: Makes a video bigger by a factor, with no model: ffmpeg resamples every frame as it streams, so a long video is never held in memory. The frame rate, the length and the sound are kept. It adds no detail; for that, use Upscale Video with Model.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.label: Scale
inputs.description: The factor of each side. Each side is rounded down to an even number of pixels, as H.264 needs.

inputs.name: method
inputs.label: Method
inputs.description: lanczos: sharp, for photos. bicubic: softer. nearest: hard pixels, for pixel art.
